d: In this video, Firstpost explains how Abdul El-Sayed, Michigan's newly elected US Senator, is winning the internet after his historic election victory. From his hilarious 'Shawarma Law' joke and unexpected skincare routine to his cheeky 'JD, Habibi' moment with Vice President JD Vance, El-Sayed's viral moments are grabbing attention. We also look at his controversial campaign, attacks over his Muslim identity, victory against Republican Mike Rogers, and his wife Sarah Jukaku's Indian connection to Bhatkal, Karnataka. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
